item.title: Didgeridoo 2.1.0
item.description:
• Presets of your own. Program › Save Preset… stores the sound as it stands under a name: every knob, the octave and the LFO amounts included. Your presets are in the Program menu below the ten built-in programs; the one in use is ticked, a double click on a knob returns its value, and Delete moves it to the Trash.
  • The app and the plug-in share the presets: each is a file in ~/Library/Application Support/Didgeridoo/Presets (Program › Show in Finder), so a sound saved in the app is in the plug-in's menu a moment later, and the files can be copied to another Mac. In a host the preset's name is the plug-in's present preset and is saved with the project.
  • The website has an instrument definition for the OXI E16 controller: the knobs by name with their MIDI controllers and the value of each knob's default place (see MIDI controllers in the manual).
